_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Helsingør (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 2 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from DSB's or Banedanmark's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

levels.name: Platform level: terminus with 3 platforms and 5 tracks — perron 1 (tracks 1/13), perron 2 (tracks 2/3), perron 3 (tracks 3/4); the 1891 station building (forhal) at the buffer end
levels.name_source: Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027 Bilag 3.6 + Banedanmark Open Data (platform register dk_register), read 2026-10-30; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Helsing%C3%B8r_railway_station, read 2026-10-30; https://wikiwand.com/da/Helsing%C3%B8r_Station (Danish Wikipedia), read 2026-10-30

sources.note: Danmarks Højdemodel, © Klimadatastyrelsen, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/860000669).
Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/banedanmark_platforms_DK.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 2).

Platform heights from Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts); 17 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/860000669).

1–2–3–4–13._source: Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts), Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 "Perronlængder og -højder" (table dated 1 August 2023), read 2026-10-30; TIB 10: tracks 2,3, class 50 cm = 0.5 m above rail, 249 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey; other rows for this track: 1,13 55 cm 0.55 m (247 m, Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 "Perronlængder og -højder" (table dated 1 August 2023), read 2026-10-30); 1,13 72 cm 0.72 m (165 m, Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 "Perronlængder og -højder" (table dated 1 August 2023), read 2026-10-30); 2,3 55 cm 0.55 m (249 m, Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 "Perronlængder og -højder" (table dated 1 August 2023), read 2026-10-30); 3,4 55 cm 0.55 m (248 m, Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 "Perronlængder og -højder" (table dated 1 August 2023), read 2026-10-30); 3,4 55 cm 0.55 m (150 m, Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 "Perronlængder og -højder" (table dated 1 August 2023), read 2026-10-30)
